title: Bayesian bivariate survival estimation
summary: There is no easy extension of Kaplan-Meier and Nelson-Aalen estimators to the bivariate case, and estimating bivariate survival distributions nonparametrically is associated with various non-trivial problems. The Dabrowska estimator will for example associate negative mass to some subsets. Bayesian methods hold some promise as they will avoid the negative mass problem, butare also prone to difficulties.
